trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Situation:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed deployment history — the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was only staging and also unhealthy).
2. Rolled back all regions to **v2.3.0**.
3. Verified recovery: service is healthy again with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure, the rollback, and a note not to redeploy v2.3.1 until root cause is identified.
